description:
Whether the next order can be placed this month, and how large, checked
month by month against the caller's cash, budget and stock limits.

`profile` is `{"business": {...}, "navigator": {...}}`. Needs
`navigator.monthly_demand_units` (a monthly rate, not one order), `business.monthly_spend_gbp` (GBP/month),
`business.cash_on_hand_gbp` and `business.monthly_revenue_gbp`; optional
`navigator` keys include `navigator.unit_sell_price_gbp`,
`supplier_deposit_pct`, `shipping_time_months` and `cash_floor_gbp`.
`corridor_id` is the lane (default: live); `regime_state` overrides
the lane's state. Returns `first_order`, `status` (`feasible`,
`best_achievable` with `compromises`, or `below_zero_no_floor`) and
`minimum_relaxation`. `deal_terms` (where enabled) judges payment terms.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
